title: Concept: Python index marked as a trusted host
description: requirements.txt declares a host on `--trusted-host`, for which certificate validation is skipped, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: TLS verification is turned off for that host by definition, so the transport no longer proves which server answered.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: TLS verification is turned off for that host by definition, so the transport no longer proves which server answered.
